policies.load: Native scoped Save sysfile.sav/tsysfile.sav first, then original Asset sav/sysfile.org/tsysfile.org, then proven constructor defaults. The latter must not manufacture a successful original disk read.
policies.save: Reviewed module writes exactly10 fixed-size records, refreshes local civil timestamp and increments SYSTEM DATA saveCount; later public14/16-record formats cannot replace this ABI.
policies.film: Out-of-range script/film arguments are the original known ignored branch. In-range bit index is script*filmsPerScript+film. Script callback passes original project script index and filmNumber-1.
policies.limits: MainControl reads original project.xtx name count, using64 if its count is0; the setter clamps2..256. Film/message strides use power-of-two grouped capacity:131072/grouped and262144/grouped respectively. Contiguous native cglist names determine CG/movie character limits.
policies.gate: Native0x5324b0 suppresses SETFILM if original background policy is disabled, or when skipNextCommand and mustSetFilmFlag0. Otherwise writes current project script index and filmNumber-1 into prepared original SystemFile. It does not write disk per command; full native save/close boundary remains pending.
policies.layout: Record-boundary/size validation must precede mutation. Preserve opaque preference, padding and unused fields. Later public SYSTEMVAR1024 and additional record families cannot replace this reviewed legacy128-word system-variable payload/10-record profile.
policies.engine_boundary: Native record layout/index/default/save policy stays in adapter. Reusable bit fields use Core integer_fields; scoped storage reads/writes and worker/cancellation/atomic completion use engine capabilities. No adapter-private generic bitmap/state service.
policies.original_saves: SystemFile progress/preferences differs from dataN.sav GAMESTATUS/effect/message/context save reconstruction. Implementing either one is not a claim that the other is done.
policies.shutdown: Installed VmAdapter.request_close admits native host quit only once a real original VM/outer state exists. Drain current resource/frame work without scheduling another native batch; known Message/Selection waits are cancelled without producing a result or ACK, unknown operations remain explicit. Scoped audio preparations/channels are released/stopped. Separate civil samples and retained atomic write receipts implement Game-loop Save and End Save; halt only after both Ready. No emulated Win32 host or process is linked.
policies.config_namespaces: MainControl loads init2/mainControl.fxf or init/mainControl.xtx separately from the game table. Missing host table keeps native defaults; malformed present table fails. initRandomSeed is host-owned; game initRandomSeed is ignored. Native atoi valid nonnumeric token yields0/no srand, which still requires actual supplied startup RNG state.
